title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on John 11: the sickness and death of Lazarus, Martha and Mary, and the call at the tomb in Bethany.

questions.text: Who was sick in Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha?
questions.explanation: A certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister Martha.

questions.text: What did Jesus say about this sickness when he heard of it?
questions.explanation: He said that this sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God's Son may be glorified by it.

answers.text: It is the result of sin
It will last only two days
It is for the glory of God

questions.text: What did Jesus do when he heard that Lazarus was sick?
questions.explanation: When he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

answers.text: He went at once to Bethany
He stayed two days where he was
He sent Thomas ahead of him

questions.text: Which disciple said, "Let's go also, that we may die with him"?
questions.explanation: Thomas, who is called Didymus, said this to his fellow disciples.

questions.text: How long had Lazarus already been in the tomb when Jesus came?
questions.explanation: When Jesus came, he found that Lazarus had been in the tomb four days already.

questions.text: What did Jesus say to Martha about himself?
questions.explanation: Jesus said to her that he is the resurrection and the life, and that whoever believes in him will still live, even if he dies.

answers.text: I am the light of the world
I am the resurrection and the life

questions.text: What did Jesus do when he saw Mary and the Jews with her weeping?
questions.explanation: He groaned in the spirit and was troubled, asked where they had laid him, and wept.

questions.text: What did Martha say when Jesus told them to take away the stone?
questions.explanation: Martha said that by this time there is a stench, for Lazarus had been dead four days.

answers.text: That the priests had sealed the tomb
That there was a stench by now
That the stone was too heavy

questions.text: What did Jesus cry with a loud voice at the tomb?
questions.explanation: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, "Lazarus, come out!"

questions.text: What did Caiaphas, the high priest that year, say to the council?
questions.explanation: He said it is advantageous for them that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.

answers.text: That Jesus should be set free
That one man should die for the people
That the Romans should be warned
